summary: IRSA, an Argentine real estate developer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a barter agreement for a 2,095 sqm lot in the Ramblas del Plata project, with an estimated saleable area of 7,483 sqm. The transaction is valued at approximately USD 6.7 million, payable via an upfront cash payment and future saleable sqm. This is a routine operational contract, not a special situation. IRSA will continue infrastructure works and commercialization. No board recommendation or advisors were named. Watch for execution of future saleable sqm deliveries and project progress.
